Name: CACL_CORRECT_GRAPH_ST
Description: Provides growth functions for various mechanics. Handles all stat scaling.

Fields.Name: Threshold Point [0]
Fields.Description: Input at which stage 0 starts. Keep it at or below the smallest real input: inputs between 0 and this value fall outside the curve.

Fields.Name: Threshold Point [1]
Fields.Description: Input at which stage 0 ends and stage 1 starts (Threshold Output [1] is reached here). Must not be lower than the previous point.

Fields.Name: Threshold Point [2]
Fields.Description: Input at which stage 1 ends and stage 2 starts (Threshold Output [2] is reached here). Must not be lower than the previous point.

Fields.Name: Threshold Point [3]
Fields.Description: Input at which stage 2 ends and stage 3 starts (Threshold Output [3] is reached here). Must not be lower than the previous point.

Fields.Name: Threshold Point [4]
Fields.Description: Input at which stage 3 ends. Inputs above this are treated as this value, so the curve stays flat at Threshold Output [4].

Fields.Name: Threshold Output [0]
Fields.Description: Output at Threshold Point [0], and for any input of 0 or less. Units depend on the system using the row.

Fields.Name: Threshold Output [1]
Fields.Description: Output at Threshold Point [1] (end of stage 0, start of stage 1).

Fields.Name: Threshold Output [2]
Fields.Description: Output at Threshold Point [2] (end of stage 1, start of stage 2).

Fields.Name: Threshold Output [3]
Fields.Description: Output at Threshold Point [3] (end of stage 2, start of stage 3).

Fields.Name: Threshold Output [4]
Fields.Description: Output at Threshold Point [4] and above (end of stage 3).

Fields.Name: Adjustment Factor [0]
Fields.Description: Curve exponent for stage 0. With t the input's position in the stage (0–1): 1 is linear, above 1 starts slow and speeds up (t^e), between 0 and 1 starts fast and slows down. Negative values mirror the curve (1 − (1 − t)^|e|), so −2 starts fast and flattens. 0 jumps straight to the stage's end output.

Fields.Name: Adjustment Factor [1]
Fields.Description: Curve exponent for stage 1 (from Threshold Point [1] to [2]). Works as Adjustment Factor [0].

Fields.Name: Adjustment Factor [2]
Fields.Description: Curve exponent for stage 2 (from Threshold Point [2] to [3]). Works as Adjustment Factor [0].

Fields.Name: Adjustment Factor [3]
Fields.Description: Curve exponent for stage 3 (from Threshold Point [3] to [4]). Works as Adjustment Factor [0].

Fields.Name: Leveling Cost - Base Multiplier
Fields.Description: Row 200 only. Level-up cost: with x = the level being bought + 80, cost = x² × (Base Multiplier + Multiplier Growth × max(0, x − Growth Threshold)) + Flat Offset, rounded down.

Fields.Name: Leveling Cost - Multiplier Growth
Fields.Description: Row 200 only. Added to the Base Multiplier for each point x is above the Growth Threshold (x = the level being bought + 80).

Fields.Name: Leveling Cost - Growth Threshold
Fields.Description: Row 200 only. Value of x (the level being bought + 80) above which Multiplier Growth starts to apply.
